memo.headline: AI Inference is a latent standalone candidate: demand signals pass, but revenue usage falls short, so diagnose the losses before investing.
memo.evidence: Behavior is the weak spot. Standalone usage share is 20.0% against a 25.0% effective threshold, and that gap is sensitive. Pipeline passes every check: standalone demand share is 22.0%, buyer-initiated share is 72.7%, and the standalone win rate is 40.0% on 10 closed deals (a small sample), against 66.7% bundled. Self-serve paid conversion within the 90-day window is 12.2% without voice and 23.8% with voice. The 12-month retention figures rest on small samples (31 standalone, 18 attached). The data is synthetic. A moderate move in the usage threshold or a larger deal sample could change the call.
